    The geometric stable constituents of a ground stable module #

    source
    def EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.GaloisConjugate (k L R : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] (X Y : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)) :
    Prop

    Two modules over the extended algebra are Galois conjugate if an additive bijection intertwines the algebra action and twists the extension scalars by one ground-field automorphism.

      The stability tests for the direct and the iterated scalar extension of the same projective weight agree under the canonical equivalence.

      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.geometric_stable_constituents (k L R : Type u) [Field k] [Finite k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] [IsAlgClosed L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k L] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)] (P : TwoTerm R) (S : FGModuleCat R) (hs : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable S) :
      ∃ (B : Fin (homFinrank k S S) → FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)), Nonempty (extendObj k L R S ≅ ⨁ B) ∧ Function.Injective (CategoryTheory.toSkeleton ∘ B) ∧ (∀ (i j : Fin (homFinrank k S S)), GaloisConjugate k L R (B i) (B j)) ∧ ∀ (i : Fin (homFinrank k S S)), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight L (extendTwoTerm k L R P)).IsStable (B i) ∧ Module.finrank L ↑(B i).obj = endolength k S ∧ homFinrank L (B i) (B i) = 1 ∧ Module.finrank k ↑S.obj = homFinrank k S S * Module.finrank L ↑(B i).obj

      Over the algebraic closure a stable ground module is a direct sum of exactly as many pairwise nonisomorphic stable modules as its endomorphism degree. Each geometric constituent has dimension equal to the endolength of the ground module.

      For each ground stable module, all stable geometric quotients of its extension form exactly one absolute Galois orbit.

      A geometric stable quotient of an extended ground stable object is a summand.

      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.ground_iso_of_common_constituent (k L R : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) {S T : FGModuleCat R} (hs : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable S) (ht : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable T) {Y : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k L R)} (hy : ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero Y) (a : CategoryTheory.Retract Y (extendObj k L R S)) (b : CategoryTheory.Retract Y (extendObj k L R T)) :
      Nonempty (S ≅ T)

      Distinct stable ground modules have disjoint sets of nonzero summands after any scalar extension. A shared summand would yield a nonzero Hom over the extension and hence already over the ground field.
